words.definition: that you can trust to do what is needed
words.example: She is a {reliable} friend who always keeps her promises.

words.definition: the time or day by which a piece of work must be finished
words.example: The {deadline} for the essay is Friday.
My {colleague} sits at the next desk.

words.definition: to talk with others to reach an agreement
words.example: The union will {negotiate} a new contract.

words.definition: the money a worker is paid every month or year
words.example: Her {salary} went up after the promotion.

words.definition: working well without wasting time or energy
